text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Excuse me, I'd like to order... Wait, 
Top Road? What are you doing behind the 
counter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tap-chan! Yes, actually—

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Is my order ready yet?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, coming right up! I'm making it now, so 
please give me just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting! To tell 
the truth, the manager suddenly fell 
ill...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But customers just keep pouring in... So I 
stepped in to help out in their place!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's real admirable of ya. But 
realistically, doin' this alone is pushin' 
it. ...There's still folks waitin', 
whatcha gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll learn the ropes as fast as I 
can and work even harder than ev—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: No. That ain't it, right? —Rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Really, are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no holdin' back! Let's conquer this 
stormy sea together!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where's the Hachimi syrup? And 
where's the recipe? —Whoa, forgot the 
payment! Hang on, I don't even know how to 
use this register!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! No way, not happening. Looks like 
this tsunami is way bigger than anything I 
imagined!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Reinforcements it is! Top Road, call in 
anyone who can give us a hand!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Tap-chan. I can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I decided to take this on myself... I 
can't cause trouble for everyone else any 
further!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So—Tap-chan, thank you so much for your 
help! I'll do my best to handle the rest 
on my own!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Top Road. That's where you're 
wrong. Not relyin' on your buddies is 
what's truly disrespectful.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Think about it the other way around—when a 
comrade is in trouble, what do you wanna 
do? Just turn a blind eye?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—If you trust 'em, you should lean on 'em! 
Precisely *because* you're buddies, it's 
okay to cause 'em some trouble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because we're buddies... it's okay to 
cause trouble...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Folks you'd back up with all your 
might no matter what— folks you can ask 
for help without second-guessing. You've 
got people like that too, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Guess I got carried away. Did I 
sound like I was preachin'?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm the one who should apologize! 
Thinking I didn't want to cause trouble 
for everyone— I was only being selfish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—I'll make the call! I have wonderful 
friends I can rely on!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: As Soon As Possible— Make it quick, buddy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day while strolling through town, I 
spotted some horse girls holding an 
after-party.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your help, everyone! 
And with that, cheers!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Cheers! Kampai!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man~ that was a crazy amount of customers. 
I actually ended up working hard for once.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Top Road's always lookin' out for me, 
anyway. Just payin' back a favor... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Man, Hachimi drinks with friends 
after a hard day's work taste the best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they really do! I'm so glad I 
reached out to everyone— and relied on 
you, Tap-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If anything happens again, call me 
right away! As long as you consider me a 
buddy, I'll always be ready to lend a 
hand!
